backend/main.mo: Main backend actor implementing pet care system with user profiles, pet management, vaccinations, video links, health content, and admin functionality. Includes access control, blob storage mixins, and CRUD operations for pets, favorites, categories, breeds, and health topics.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report documenting two high-confidence features: debugging admin button visibility in Navbar and verifying useCallerRole hook admin identification in production.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Comprehensive summaries of frontend source files covering components, pages, hooks, utilities, and content catalogs for the pet care system UI.
frontend/index.css: Tailwind CSS configuration with custom CSS variables for light and dark themes, defining colors for UI elements like background, foreground, primary, secondary, destructive, borders, and sidebar components.
frontend/index.html: HTML entry point for the Pet Care and Guidance System React application, loading the main TypeScript module.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Root application component defining TanStack Router configuration with routes for home, auth, dashboard, profile, pets, health, AI assistant, and admin pages, including RequireAuth and RequireAdmin guards.
frontend/src/components/admin/AdminShell: Reusable admin layout wrapper component providing consistent header, breadcrumb navigation, title, description, and container styling for admin pages.
frontend/src/components/admin/AdminVideo: Admin component for managing video links filtered by breed, pet category, or health topic with edit/delete actions and empty state handling when no breeds exist.
frontend/src/components/admin/BlobImageU: A React component for uploading images to blob storage with preview, progress tracking, validation (type and 5MB size limit), and clear functionality.
frontend/src/components/ai/behavior/Beha: A multi-step form component that collects pet behavior data (species, appetite, activity, behavior changes) and displays rule-based health assessment results with concern levels and next steps.
frontend/src/components/ai/breed/BreedId: A developer testing tool that runs automated test cases against the breed identification logic, displaying pass/fail results with confidence scores and pass rate statistics.
An image upload component that identifies pet breeds from filenames and optional hints, displaying results with confidence levels, explanations, and links to breed information.
frontend/src/components/ai/emergency/Eme: A multi-step wizard that collects pet symptom information (symptom, frequency, duration) and provides rule-based emergency triage assessment with urgency levels and recommended actions.
frontend/src/components/auth/RequireAdmi: An authentication wrapper component that checks both user authentication and admin role, displaying access denied message or loading state before rendering protected admin content.
frontend/src/components/auth/RequireAuth: An authentication guard component that redirects unauthenticated users to login while storing their intended destination, showing loading state during initialization.
frontend/src/components/common/CatalogIm: A reusable image component with automatic fallback handling that switches to a fallback source on load error and supports lazy loading.
frontend/src/components/common/SectionCa: A reusable card component that wraps content with optional title and description using shadcn/ui Card components.
frontend/src/components/favorites/Favori: A button component that toggles favorite status for videos, requiring authentication and showing star icon with filled/unfilled states.
frontend/src/components/layout/AppLayout: Main layout wrapper component that provides consistent structure with Navbar, main content area, and Footer.
frontend/src/components/media/CatalogIma: Image component with error handling that falls back to a placeholder image when the source fails to load.
frontend/src/components/media/YouTubeEmb: Embeds YouTube videos with iframe or fallback link, includes video title and optional favorite button integration.
frontend/src/components/navigation/Bread: Renders breadcrumb navigation with home icon and chevron separators, supporting linked and non-linked items.
frontend/src/components/navigation/Foote: Footer component displaying copyright, caffeine.ai attribution, and veterinary disclaimer text.
frontend/src/components/navigation/Navba: Main navigation bar with responsive mobile menu, authentication controls, and conditional admin link based on user role.
frontend/src/components/onboarding/Dashb: Onboarding form for adding a user's first pet with fields for name, type, age, gender, and vaccination information.
frontend/src/components/profile/Favorite: Manages user's saved favorite videos with list display and remove functionality, ensuring profile exists before operations.
frontend/src/components/profile/PetsMana: CRUD interface for managing user's pets with dialog form for add/edit, photo upload support, and profile existence checks.
frontend/src/components/profile/ProfileE: React component for editing user profile information including name, email, and profile photo with blob image upload support. Handles profile creation for new users and updates for existing profiles.
frontend/src/components/profile/Vaccinat: React component for managing pet vaccination records, allowing users to add vaccinations with due dates and frequencies, and mark them as completed. Includes dialog-based form for adding new vaccination entries.
frontend/src/content/health/healthCatalo: Defines health topic data structures and catalog containing pet health information organized by categories (grooming, nutrition, vaccination, emergency) with symptoms, causes, prevention tips, and video resources.
Contains breed information catalog for cats (Persian, Siamese, Maine Coon, British Shorthair, Ragdoll) with details on temperament, diet, care tips, health issues, and educational videos.
frontend/src/content/pets/petsCatalog.ts: Defines pet catalog structure with categories (cats, dogs, birds, other) and subcategories, including detailed care information for small mammals, reptiles, and other exotic pets.
frontend/src/content/recommendations.ts: Provides daily rotating care tips and recommended video content for pet owners, with functions to retrieve day-specific tips and curated educational videos.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Custom React hook that manages backend actor creation with Internet Identity authentication, handling both authenticated and anonymous actors, and invalidating dependent queries on identity changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useAdminVideos.ts: Provides React Query hooks for managing admin video links: fetching videos by category, adding, updating, and removing video links with automatic cache invalidation.
frontend/src/hooks/useCallerRole.ts: Custom hook that checks if the authenticated user has admin privileges by querying the backend actor, with caching and detailed debug logging.
Exports React Query hooks for managing pet categories and breeds: fetching all categories/breeds, filtering breeds by category, and CRUD operations with cache invalidation.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Provides React context and hooks for Internet Identity authentication, managing login/logout flow, identity persistence, and authentication status with configurable AuthClient options.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Comprehensive React Query hooks for user profiles, pets, vaccinations, favorites, and video management with automatic cache updates and invalidation strategies.
frontend/src/hooks/useVaccinationDueToda: Custom hook that displays a countdown timer showing time remaining until end of day for vaccination reminders, updating every second when user is authenticated.
frontend/src/index.css: Tailwind CSS configuration with custom design tokens for light/dark themes, admin-specific styling with warm amber/orange tones, and utility classes for consistent spacing and effects.
Rule-based assessment system that scores pet health concerns based on appetite, activity, and behavior changes, returning severity levels with actionable next steps.
Implements breed identification logic by tokenizing and scoring filename and hint text against a breed catalog, returning the best match with confidence level and explanation.
frontend/src/lib/ai/breedIdentificationT: Defines test cases for breed identification with various filename patterns, hints, and expected breed matches for Persian, British Shorthair, Maine Coon, and Golden Retriever breeds.
frontend/src/lib/ai/emergencyTriageRules: Assesses pet symptom urgency (high/medium/low) based on keywords and frequency, returning appropriate messages and action recommendations for each urgency level.
frontend/src/lib/vaccinationReminders.ts: Calculates vaccination reminder messages and urgency variants based on due dates, and provides countdown formatting utilities for time-sensitive reminders.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Application entry point that sets up React root with QueryClient, InternetIdentityProvider, and renders the main App component.
frontend/src/pages/admin/AdminBreedsPage: Admin page for managing pet breeds with CRUD operations, including name, category, description, image upload, and video links. Uses dialog forms for add/edit and integrates with content management hooks.
frontend/src/pages/admin/AdminCategories: Admin page for managing pet categories with CRUD operations, including name, description, image upload, and video links. Similar structure to AdminBreedsPage but without category selection.
frontend/src/pages/admin/AdminLandingPag: Admin dashboard landing page displaying three navigation cards for managing pet categories, breeds, and video links. Provides overview and entry points to admin sections.
frontend/src/pages/admin/AdminVideosPage: Admin page for managing video links categorized by breed, pet category, or health topic. Includes tabbed interface and form dialog for adding/editing videos with category-specific selection.
frontend/src/pages/ai/AIAssistantPage.ts: AI assistant page with tabbed interface for emergency triage, health assessment, and breed identification features. Includes disclaimer alert and optional developer test harness for breed identification.
frontend/src/pages/auth/ForgotPasswordPa: Account recovery page explaining Internet Identity authentication system and directing users to external Internet Identity recovery process. No password reset functionality as authentication is delegated.
frontend/src/pages/auth/LoginPage.tsx: Login page component that handles Internet Identity authentication with support for admin-specific login flows, error handling, and post-login redirection to the intended destination or dashboard.
frontend/src/pages/auth/SignupPage.tsx: Signup page component that creates new accounts via Internet Identity, displaying benefits of the platform and redirecting authenticated users to the dashboard.
frontend/src/pages/DashboardPage.tsx: Displays user dashboard with pet overview, vaccination reminders, daily care tips, and recommended videos; includes onboarding flow for new users without pets.
frontend/src/pages/health/HealthCareLand: Landing page displaying four health care categories (Grooming, Nutrition, Vaccination, Emergency Care) as navigable cards with icons and descriptions.
frontend/src/pages/health/HealthCategory: Category page that displays all topics within a selected health category (e.g., grooming, nutrition) as a grid of clickable cards with breadcrumb navigation.
frontend/src/pages/health/HealthTopicPag: Detailed health topic page showing symptoms, causes, prevention, immediate care steps, and video guides, with support for admin-managed videos and emergency alerts.
frontend/src/pages/HomePage.tsx: Landing page showcasing platform features (pet information, health guidance, AI assistant, vaccination reminders) with hero section and call-to-action buttons.
Breed detail page displaying comprehensive information about a specific pet breed including images, description, temperament, diet, and videos from both static catalog and backend sources with favorite functionality.
frontend/src/pages/pets/BreedListPage.ts: Breed listing page showing all breeds for a pet category as a grid of cards with images and descriptions, supporting both backend-managed and static catalog breeds.
Displays a pet category page with breadcrumbs, category image/description, optional breed navigation button, and subcategories with pet links. Merges backend category data with static catalog fallback.
frontend/src/pages/pets/PetDetailPage.ts: Shows detailed information for a specific pet including image, description, care requirements checklist, helpful videos, and quick facts sidebar. Searches for pet data across category subcategories.
Landing page displaying four core pet categories (Cats, Dogs, Birds, Other Pets) as cards with icons and descriptions. Merges backend category data with static definitions when available.
frontend/src/pages/ProfilePage.tsx: Profile management page with tabbed interface for editing user profile, managing pets, tracking vaccinations, and organizing favorites.
frontend/src/utils/catalogRouting.ts: Provides utility functions for normalizing category/breed names to URL slugs, mapping between backend names and frontend route slugs, and checking slug matches for consistent routing.
frontend/src/utils/petTypeHelpers.ts: Helper functions for converting between PetType discriminated union and strings, getting display names, and comparing PetType equality.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Utilities for extracting URL parameters from query strings or hash-based routing, persisting parameters in sessionStorage, and clearing sensitive parameters from URLs without page reload.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind CSS configuration defining custom color schemes (including admin theme), container settings, extended utilities, animations, and plugin integrations for typography and container queries.
project_state.json: Project state tracking admin button visibility issue in production, with features for debugging Navbar component and useCallerRole hook, plus pending backend admin verification requirement.
